# From Azure DevOps pipelines

After a Cursor plugin install, the short command loop is [plugins/crav1/README.md](../plugins/crav1/README.md).

When the user asks for startup options, that ask names only `/crav1-spark-to-spec`, `/crav1-ideas-to-spec`, `/crav1-bundle-to-specs`, `/crav1-existing-to-specs`, `/crav1-read-environment`, and `/crav1-fix-bug`.

It lists and shows with `az pipelines` and `az devops`. The stage name gives the environment, with the same whole-word rule as `/crav1-read-environment`.

There is no `shared` word. The next `/crav1-read-environment` treats that disagreement as shared.

If `az` is missing, the `azure-devops` extension is missing, or there is no login, the stop names which. The install page and `az extension add --name azure-devops` are the pointers. The login commands are `az login` and `az devops configure --defaults`.

## First prompt

```text
/crav1-map-pipeline-environments

Azure DevOps. Org: <org>. Project: <project>.
Read the pipeline definitions. Do not run a pipeline. Do not guess the org.
```

## Steps

| Phase | You | Agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pointer | Named Azure DevOps, the org, and the project | Stops when one of those is missing. Does not guess. A pipeline name is optional |
| CLI | `az` and the `azure-devops` extension, already logged in | Names whichever is missing. Does not install or log in |
| Definitions | — | YAML stages and classic release stages. List and show only. Secrets stay unprinted |
| Cases | Read every item | One environment, shared, or unclear. A shared resource is two environments, one line each. Unclear proposes no mark |
| Sections | Answer every section in one batch | Every item stays listed. Only a confirmed line is appended |
| Stop | `/crav1-read-environment` next | Does not run that command. Names `/crav1-finalize-commit` when a file changed. Does not commit |

## What gets written

`docs/environments/marks.md` can gain a line the user confirmed. The source is `pipeline <name>, stage <stage>`.

No `docs/system`.

## Branches (1.69.0)

After Unclear, a fourth section, **Branches**, proposes `docs/environments/promotion.md` lines from the same definitions: a YAML `trigger:` branch list, a stage `condition:` on `Build.SourceBranch`, a classic release's artifact branch filter, and `refs/tags/` triggers as tag lines. For example `orders-api | develop | test | pipeline orders-cd, stage DeployTest` and `orders-api | main | prod | pipeline orders-cd, stage DeployProd`. It still reads definitions only, never runs. Status then shows a `Promotion:` line.

## After

```text
Run next:
The pipeline read is not a host read.

Read the host:
`/crav1-read-environment`
Uncommitted: 1 file; commit with /crav1-finalize-commit when ready.
```
